name: @playliquid/build-contracts
description: PlayLiquid GameOS build pipeline contract layer (PL-008). Typed build inputs (GameIR digest + package lock + target profile + engine binding + toolchain/environment profile), build outputs (CAS artifact records, build manifest, provenance and verification evidence), build request/command contracts with idempotency keys (E6), the frozen build-stage state machine, and the pure BuildExecutor port. Pure types and pure functions only: no IO, no toolchain invocation, no engine SDKs, no artifact math (the digest/CAS authority is @playliquid/package-system, E7).
